key_insight: ARDY enables real-time interactive human motion generation by combining autoregressive streaming with a hybrid representation that balances precise control and efficient learning.
engineering_relevance: It is useful for animation, simulation, and humanoid robotics because it supports online text prompts and flexible kinematic constraints without sacrificing motion quality.
method: Hybrid representation: explicit root features plus a latent body embedding.
Two-stage autoregressive transformer denoiser with variable history context.
Conditions on online text and long-horizon kinematic constraints sampled from ground-truth motions.
evidence_signal: The method is evaluated on HumanML3D and the large-scale Bones Rigplay dataset, where the abstract reports strong motion quality and constraint adherence.
watch_item: Interactive controllability may depend on the quality and availability of training data and constraint sampling, so generalization to novel motions or prompts may still need careful validation.
paper_title: ARDY: Autoregressive Diffusion with Hybrid Representation for Interactive Human Motion Generation
